relationships.subject: olcegepant
relationships.evidence_quote: The current findings demonstrated that the CGRP antagonist olcegepant was effective for reducing nociception associated with oral cancer.

relationships.subject: CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: This study demonstrates that CGRP contributes to oral cancer pain, suggesting the antagonism of CGRP signaling to treat oral cancer pain.

relationships.subject: olcegepant
relationships.evidence_quote: CGRP antagonism reverses oral cancer nociception in preclinical oral cancer pain models.

key_findings: CGRP-ir neurites innervate oral cancer xenografts and cancer increases anterograde CGRP transport; the CGRP antagonist olcegepant reversed oral cancer nociception in paw and tongue models.
Ramp1 and Calcrl are more frequently detected in fibroblasts and immune cells of the xenograft microenvironment.
